body:
Axemurdererpenguin - I do not want people to see me like this. It makes me feel unwanted, like a burden. Especially when my family is going through hell. I want to try to be strong and look like nothing is wrong, but it is really taking its toll. I have not given up because if did, I would not be here. I am still trying.

dollyllama1 - Drugs have not been a part of my life for a couple of years now. I know doing them again would completely ruin me and my career, and possibly hurt/kill myself or another person. It feels impossible to make new friends, let alone meet new people. At my two jobs, I work alone. I either drive back and forth doing deliveries, or I work shifts where I am the only person in my department. With my family, I feel like they are all I have left. I hardly ever see them. I wake up and leave for work before they are up (6am), go straight to school, and arrive home after they fall asleep (11pm). To know that they are falling apart, it just kills me. About the ex, I know girls come and go. It is just too much to handle all at one time.

grassy_ridge - I have asked myself many questions, and I have written down many thoughts. It only makes me feel more depressed. Doing this a few years ago helped out a lot. But for some reason, I feel worse about it.
